scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=@kinloom/core && npm run build --workspace=@kinloom/server && npm run build --workspace=@kinloom/worker && npm run build --workspace=@kinloom/cli && npm run build --workspace=@kinloom/ui && npm run build --workspace=@kinloom/demo
scripts.typecheck: tsc --noEmit -p packages/core/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/server/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/worker/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/cli/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p packages/ui/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p examples/demo/tsconfig.json && tsc --noEmit -p e2e/tsconfig.json
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build:data --workspace=@kinloom/demo && npm run build --workspace=@kinloom/demo && playwright test
scripts.test:cwv: npm run build:data --workspace=@kinloom/demo && npm run build --workspace=@kinloom/demo && KINLOOM_CWV_BUDGET=1 playwright test e2e/cwv-budget.spec.ts
scripts.check: npm run check:arch && npm run lint && npm run build && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run check:contrast && npm run check:leaks
